snippet.title: Good Heavens! Gameplay Teaser Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
Another hero. What is this, a subscription service?

Xant-Rar is falling apart. Danger is everywhere, protests are spreading, the economy is collapsing, and somehow the answer is... another Chosen One.

Our new Good Heavens! Gameplay Teaser Trailer gives you a fresh look at the chaos, charm, and divine oversight waiting ahead.

Have a watch and let us know what caught your eye most. We’d love to hear your thoughts.

Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617120/Good_Heavens/?utm_source=StreamQuest
